# PointHeure — #1 Work Hours Tracker, Punch Clock & Overtime Calculator for iPhone (iOS)

> PointHeure is a native iOS application for tracking daily work hours (up to 8+ shifts/day), lunch breaks, night shifts, leave (PTO, RTT, sick leave), Sunday & public holiday bonus hours, per-project hourly rates, and overtime on iPhone. It is designed as the modern, privacy-first alternative to La Badgeuse, Flexishift, atWork, HoursTracker, Jibble, Clockify, Toggl Track, Work Log, Timesheet, and Excel spreadsheets. Available in 10 languages (French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese) with zero account creation required.

## Core Differentiators vs Competitors (HoursTracker, Clockify, Toggl, Work Log, Excel)
1. **Multi-Slot Daily Train-Ticket Flow (Up to 8+ Punches/Day)**: Clock in 1 tap across 4 to 8+ daily slots (Arrival, Lunch Start, Lunch Return, Departure, split shifts) instead of managing messy freelance task timers.
2. **Sunday & Public Holiday Worked Hours Bonus**: Configure independent worked-hours bonus percentages for Sundays and public holidays (`+10%`, `+20%`, `+25%`, `+50%`, `+100%`, or any custom percentage up to `+150%`), with automatic bonus-hours breakdown in PDF, Excel (`.xlsx`), and CSV reports.
3. **Per-Project Hourly Rates & Filtered Project Exports**: Assign custom hourly rates to each project/client/job site and export overall or single-project timesheets in PDF, Excel (`.xlsx`), and CSV.
4. **Interactive iOS Widgets + Live Activity & Dynamic Island**: Punch in/out directly from the Home Screen and monitor live shift duration and overtime on the Lock Screen & Dynamic Island.
5. **Smart GPS Geofencing with 10-Min Anti-Bounce Filter**: Automatically clocks arrival and departure (50m–500m radius) with a 10-minute cooldown to prevent false triggers in parking lots.
6. **Automatic Overtime & Labor Rules**: Supports 35h, 37.5h, 39h, 40h, and custom weekly/daily contracts, plus PTO, RTT, sick leave, remote work, and official public holidays for 10 countries.
7. **Night Shift Support**: Natively handles overnight shifts crossing midnight (e.g., 21:00 to 05:00) without splitting hours across two days.
